description: Repository code-file inventory for agentic navigation.

files.package.json: Project metadata, dependencies, and package scripts.
files.scripts/convert-icons.sh: Converts source icon assets into application icon sizes.
files.src/main.tsx: React application bootstrap and root mount.
files.src/app/App.tsx: Top-level application state and editor/player screen switching.
files.src/components/TimerRing.tsx: Circular timer display used by the session player.
files.src/components/index.ts: Public barrel exports for shared components.
files.src/config/practice-config.ts: Typed practice settings derived from the YAML configuration.
files.src/config/practice-config.test.ts: Tests for practice-configuration constraints and values.
files.src/config/practice.yml: Source configuration for duration, tempo, interaction, and sound policies.
files.src/domain/routine.ts: Routine, exercise, and break domain types plus constructors.
files.src/domain/routine.test.ts: Tests for routine domain constructors and modes.
files.src/domain/session.ts: Session-plan, step, and Quick Rest domain types.
files.src/features/routine-editor/types.ts: Routine editor public props and editor-sheet state types.
files.src/features/routine-editor/RoutineEdito: Routine editor feature composition and public exports.
files.src/features/routine-editor/useRoutineEd: Routine editor state, persistence, validation, and mutation hook.
files.src/features/routine-editor/RoutineSetti: Quick Rest, warning, and Metronome sound settings UI.
files.src/features/routine-editor/RoutineEntry: Ordered list of editable routine entries.
Single routine-entry summary, edit, and delete controls.
Bottom-sheet forms for routine names and routine entries.
files.src/features/routine-editor/routineTotal: Calculates a routine's estimated total duration.
files.src/features/routine-editor/RoutineEdito: Integration tests for routine editing interactions.
files.src/features/routine-editor/routineTotal: Unit tests for routine duration totals.
files.src/features/session-player/SessionPlaye: Session-player feature composition and public props.
files.src/features/session-player/useSessionPl: Session Runner lifecycle, audio, wake-lock, and live override hook.
files.src/features/session-player/SessionTimer: Timer Ring content, tempo controls, and session illustration selection.
files.src/features/session-player/SessionContr: Playback, rewind, stop, and finish/skip controls.
files.src/features/session-player/NowPlayingSh: Read-only session-step list shown in the Now Playing sheet.
files.src/features/session-player/EndScreen.ts: Completed and stopped session end state screen.
files.src/features/session-player/SessionIllus: Illustrations for exercise, break, and Quick Rest timer states.
files.src/features/session-player/formatTime.t: Formats elapsed and remaining seconds as minutes and seconds.
files.src/features/session-player/stepMetadata: Formats a session step for headings and Now Playing rows.
files.src/features/session-player/SessionPlaye: Integration tests for session-player interactions and states.
files.src/features/session-player/sessionPlaye: Unit tests for extracted session-player utilities and stop slider.
files.src/services/audio/AudioController.ts: Schedules Metronome beats and playback cues through the Web Audio API.
files.src/services/audio/index.ts: Public barrel export for audio services.
files.src/services/audio/__tests__/AudioContro: Tests for audio scheduling and cue behaviour.
files.src/services/persistence/routine-reposit: Browser-storage routine repository implementation and interface.
files.src/services/platform/wakeLock.ts: Wraps browser wake-lock acquisition and release.
files.src/services/session/SessionRunner.ts: Coordinates session progression, timing, and lifecycle events.
files.src/services/session/buildSessionSteps.t: Builds immutable session plans from routines.
files.src/services/session/sessionReducer.ts: State reducer and initial state for session execution.
files.src/services/session/session.test.ts: Tests for session planning, runner, and reducer behaviour.
files.src/test/setup.ts: Vitest and Testing Library test environment setup.
files.tsconfig.app.json: TypeScript configuration for browser application code.
files.tsconfig.node.json: TypeScript configuration for Vite and Node-side configuration.
files.vite.config.ts: Vite, React, PWA, and test runner configuration.
